title: Federal Government / National Aggregate
description: United States federal government or combined nationwide state and local total

title: State Government
description: The primary governing body of one of the 50 states or commonwealths

title: County Government
description: Organized county governments providing general countywide public administration (parishes in LA, boroughs in AK)

title: Municipal Government
description: Incorporated cities, towns, boroughs, and villages established for general local government in defined population concentrations

title: Township / Town Government
description: Organized governments in 20 northeastern and midwestern states providing local services outside incorporated municipalities

title: Special District Government
description: Independent single-function or multi-function local authorities (water, transit, housing, fire, port, hospital, conservation)

title: Independent School District Government
description: Independent local public school systems with separate fiscal and administrative autonomy
